empty.reason: The panel is itself the empty-ish state of a map. It renders only when nothing has worked the map, and when there is no seed idea to show it drops the quote and points at the brief instead - that is the FromBrief scenario, not a separate empty one.

many.reason: It renders one card of fixed copy, never a list, so there is no overflow or truncation boundary. Length variation is the edge archetype, covered by LongIdea.

loading.reason: Nothing here is asynchronous. The panel reads bridge state already resolved by the provider and renders synchronously; there is no pending phase to picture.

error.reason: There is no failure this panel can be in. Its whole purpose is to state an ordinary absence honestly - the states where it must NOT render are asserted in AgentHandoff.render.test.tsx, where 'nothing' is a real assertion rather than a blank frame.

key-interaction.reason: Its one action is the copy button, which belongs to CopyablePrompt and is recorded on that view. The copied label needs a successful navigator.clipboard write, which the capture browser refuses.

single.reason: A map has exactly one brief or none - it is written once at creation and never replaced - so there is no list here and no empty-to-many boundary. The one-item case IS the typical case, captured as BriefDrop - Attached.

many.reason: One brief per map is a schema-level rule: MapBrief.mapId is unique and the row is never overwritten. Attaching a second brief is not an action this surface offers, so a many state cannot occur.

loading.reason: The in-flight upload state is internal to this component - it is set when the fetch starts and cleared when it returns, with no prop seam to preset it - so it cannot be captured at this level. The pixels it produces ARE captured one level down, where the state is a prop: BriefDropTarget - Reading.

error.reason: Both failure states are held below this component and captured there: an upload that failed is BriefDropTarget - Failed, and a file that extracted to almost nothing is BriefReadout - ScannedPdf. This component owns the error string but renders none of it itself.

loading.reason: The region is server-rendered from nodes already in hand - buildSequence is a pure function over an in-memory list, so there is no fetch that could be pending.

error.reason: There is no failure path to render. The two things that can go wrong with a slice - naming no node, or naming a deleted one - are modelled as ordinary reported states, and each has its own scenario.

key-interaction.reason: The region is read-only: it renders slices and binds no handlers. The plan is something the client reads and argues with, not something they operate.

empty.reason: The only caller builds the text from handoffCopy, which always returns a non-empty prompt. An empty string would render an empty bordered box, which is a caller bug rather than a state of this component.

many.reason: This renders one block of text, never a list, so there is no overflow or truncation boundary to show. Length variation is the edge archetype, covered by ShortPrompt and DefaultLabel.

loading.reason: There is nothing asynchronous to wait for on render. The clipboard write is instantaneous from the component's point of view and resolves into the copied label, not a loading state.

error.reason: The failure path - a refused or unavailable clipboard - is deliberately indistinguishable from the resting state: the button simply does not change, and the text stays on screen so the person can select it by hand. It is therefore already shown by Default, and a separate capture would be a byte-identical duplicate.

key-interaction.reason: The copied label is reachable only through a successful navigator.clipboard write, which the capture browser refuses - a registered interaction scenario captured the pre-click state and was deleted rather than shipped as a misleading duplicate of Default. The state is covered instead by app/components/AgentHandoff.render.test.tsx and the CopyablePrompt behaviour is asserted there rather than pictured.

loading.reason: The landing route is server-rendered with force-dynamic: the saved-map list is resolved before any HTML is sent, so the page has no pending state to show.

error.reason: This route has no server-side failure mode - it renders a list. The only error surface is the inline create failure inside IdeaPrompt, which is client-transient and cannot be produced from a seed; the same inline treatment is captured on ReplyForm - WithError.

empty.reason: A thinking map always carries its seed idea as the root node - the idea is what creates the map - so a map with zero nodes cannot occur. The nearest real state is the root alone, recorded under single as the Just started scenario.

loading.reason: The map route is server-rendered with force-dynamic: the conversation and node tree are resolved before any HTML is sent, so there is no pending state on the page.

error.reason: A missing map id is handled by notFound, which renders the framework 404 rather than a state of this view. The reply failure is client-transient and cannot be seeded; its inline treatment is captured on ReplyForm - WithError.

loading.reason: The route is force-dynamic and server-renders the map with its log already read, so the page never paints a pending state - by the time MapScreen mounts, its data is resolved.

key-interaction.reason: MapScreen composes the surface; answering a question - the key action on this view - is owned by the card that asks it and is captured as MapCardAnswer - ChipFilledTheBox and MapCard - EditingAnAnswer, driven as real interactions rather than duplicated here.

loading.reason: The workspace is server-rendered from the map with its event log already read, so it has no in-flight state of its own. The one piece of waiting a person sees is an answer being sent from a card, which is held inside MapCardAnswer and captured on that view.

error.reason: The workspace renders whatever the map contains and has no failure state of its own: a missing map is a 404 before this view mounts, and a failed answer write is rolled back inside useMapAnswers so the card returns to asking rather than the workspace showing an error.

empty.reason: The empty case renders nothing at all by design - a blank seed idea produces no element rather than empty quote marks. A capture of it would be an empty frame indistinguishable from a broken one, so it is pinned in handoffCopy.test.ts and the AgentHandoff render tests instead.

many.reason: It renders exactly one quote, never a list. Length variation is the edge archetype, covered by LongIdea and ShortIdea.

loading.reason: It is a pure presentational component over a string prop with no asynchronous work, so there is no pending phase.

error.reason: It takes a single optional string and has no failure mode; an absent value is the blank case, which renders nothing by design.

key-interaction.reason: It is static text with no handlers - there is no action a person can take on it.

empty.reason: A card always renders exactly one slice - there is no zero-slice card. The empty state belongs to BuildSequence, the region that decides whether there is anything to list, and it is covered there.

many.reason: One card is one increment by definition. Many slices is BuildSequence's state, not this component's, and it is covered there.

loading.reason: Props in, markup out. Nothing is fetched, so nothing can be pending.

error.reason: No failure path. A slice that settles nothing, or names a deleted node, is a legitimate state this card is built to report - each has its own scenario rather than being an error.

key-interaction.reason: Purely presentational - no handlers, no controls. Nothing on the card responds to being touched.

single.reason: The summary is five regions rendered at once, so a one-item state is not a state of this screen - it belongs to the individual cards, and BulletCard, NextStepsTrack and BuildSequence each cover it in isolation.

many.reason: Composition only - this component sorts nothing and truncates nothing. Overflow is each region's own state and is covered where the rendering actually happens.

loading.reason: Server-rendered from the map's nodes, which the route has already loaded. There is no fetch on this screen to be pending.

error.reason: No failure path here. A region with nothing to show renders its own hint, which is the NoSlices and Empty scenarios rather than an error.

key-interaction.reason: Read-only composition with no handlers. The one place to act on this screen is KeepThinkingPanel, which sits outside SummaryView and is covered separately.

error.reason: The bridge has no error surface: a tool fault is returned to the AGENT as isError in the tool result, and a conflict or timeout is deliberately a normal result rather than an error. Nothing about a failure renders on the page, so there is no error state for a person to see here.
